course:firstWeek.title: World foundations
course:firstWeek.title__note: Name of the first-week course (packages/content/packs/courses/first-week.v1.json). Shown when the whole course is finished. A name, not a promise: never 'master the world'. Max 28 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.first.title: First countries
course:firstWeek.unit.first.title__note: Title of unit 1 on the Home path, under 'UNIT 1'. The unit practises six countries by flag, place and capital. No number in the title, because the count is data and can change with the course. Max 24 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.first.objective: Know each one by its flag, place and capital.
course:firstWeek.unit.first.objective__n: One-line objective under the unit title on Home. 'Each one' = each country in the unit. Recognition, not mastery — never say 'master'. Max 60 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.continents.title: Across the continents
course:firstWeek.unit.continents.title__: Title of unit 2 on the Home path: new countries from several continents, then everything mixed, then a check. Max 24 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.continents.objecti: Add new countries, then mix everything you know.
One-line objective under the unit 2 title. Invitation, not instruction. Max 60 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.europe.title: Europe
course:firstWeek.unit.europe.title__note: Title of the Europe unit on the Home path (unit 3 in course v1.1.0): European countries the first week did not have. The continent's everyday name. Max 24 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.europe.objective__: One-line objective under the unit's title. An invitation, not an instruction; no count, because how many countries a unit holds is data and changes with the course. Max 60 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.americas.title: The Americas
course:firstWeek.unit.americas.title__no: Title of the unit for North, Central and South America and the Caribbean, as one. Swedish 'Amerika' is the whole double continent here, never the United States. Max 24 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.americas.objective: Meet more countries in the Americas.
One-line objective under the unit's title. An invitation, not an instruction; no count, because how many countries a unit holds is data and changes with the course. Max 60 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.asiaOceania.title: Asia and Oceania
course:firstWeek.unit.asiaOceania.title_: Title of the unit for Asia and the Pacific together (Oceania has too few countries in the packs for a unit of its own). Max 24 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.asiaOceania.object: Meet more countries in Asia and Oceania.
One-line objective under the unit's title. An invitation, not an instruction; no count, because how many countries a unit holds is data and changes with the course. Max 60 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.africa.title: Africa
course:firstWeek.unit.africa.title__note: Title of the Africa unit on the Home path. The continent's everyday name. Max 24 characters.
course:firstWeek.unit.africa.objective__: One-line objective under the unit's title. An invitation, not an instruction; no count, because how many countries a unit holds is data and changes with the course. Max 60 characters.
course:firstWeek.node.flags: {count, plural, one {Match # flag to its country.} other {Match # flags to their countries.}}
course:firstWeek.node.flags__note: Objective of a step on the path. {count} is how many countries the step covers, read from the course pack. A whole sentence: it is also read out inside the step's screen-reader label. ICU plural. Every unit's step of this kind uses this sentence, so it names no unit or continent.
course:firstWeek.node.locations: {count, plural, one {Find where # country is in the world.} other {Find where # countries are in the world.}}
course:firstWeek.node.locations__note: Objective of the 'where is it' step. Deliberately not 'on the map': a screen-reader user answers the same questions in words. {count} is how many countries. ICU plural. Every unit's step of this kind uses this sentence, so it names no unit or continent.
course:firstWeek.node.capitals: {count, plural, one {Match # country to its capital.} other {Match # countries to their capitals.}}
course:firstWeek.node.capitals__note: Objective of the capitals step. {count} is how many countries. ICU plural. Every unit's step of this kind uses this sentence, so it names no unit or continent.
course:firstWeek.node.newCountries: {count, plural, one {Recognise # new country by flag and place.} other {Recognise # new countries by flag and place.}}
course:firstWeek.node.newCountries__note: Objective of the first step of unit 2: countries not practised before, by their flag and where they are. {count} is how many. ICU plural. Every unit's step of this kind uses this sentence, so it names no unit or continent.
course:firstWeek.node.allCapitals: {count, plural, one {Match # country to its capital.} other {Match all # countries to their capitals.}}
course:firstWeek.node.allCapitals__note: Objective of the step that brings back every capital so far, old and new. {count} is how many countries. ICU plural. Every unit's step of this kind uses this sentence, so it names no unit or continent.
course:firstWeek.node.mixed: {count, plural, one {Mix flag, place and capital for # country.} other {Mix flags, places and capitals for all # countries.}}
course:firstWeek.node.mixed__note: Objective of the step that asks every kind of question about every country so far. {count} is how many countries. ICU plural. Every unit's step of this kind uses this sentence, so it names no unit or continent.
course:firstWeek.node.check: Check what stayed with you, starting with what's due.
course:firstWeek.node.check__note: Objective of the closing check of the course: questions about everything so far, the ones due for review first. Calm and factual — a check, not a test to pass or fail. Never 'final exam'. Every unit's step of this kind uses this sentence, so it names no unit or continent.
